newEntry.name: Hang & Trace
newEntry.desc: Snip twelve runners, cross-lap a curve board onto two feet and drape a cord against a calculated engraved catenary. Measured sheet/carrier reference, adjustable eye span, sag and calibrated joints; local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL grips, connected-card and per-part STL/ZIP. Cord and adhesive required; ideal curve, no physical drape test.
